description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

This time, we’re in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan Province — and probably one of the most underrated cities in China when it comes to food.
Yunnan cuisine is arguably the wildest in China. From incredibly delicious rice noodles and local coffee to insects and all kinds of unusual ingredients, this cuisine really has it all. With 27 ethnic minority groups living across Yunnan, Kunming is one of the country’s great food destinations.
